name: Kosmos-212
about: Kosmos-212 (1968-029A), a crewed vehicle (7K-OK), launched 1968 Apr 14. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1968 Apr 15), held fixed
docked to S03193; it stays docked here until it lands; the undocking is folded into the landing (a fudge of hours)
the landing time is GCAT's end of mission (psatcat TDate); the point stands in for the programme's usual recovery area, from memory

events.why: the landing time is GCAT's end of mission (psatcat TDate)
